question: A candle shop had 47 candles in stock, tracked over 60 minutes, or 1 hour, of the morning. Six more matching shipments made the total seven times as large. A late delivery added 79 more candles. A big sale sold 129 candles. A donation added 38 more. Three more matching shipments made the total four times as large. Finally, the stock was split evenly across 4 storerooms, and only one storeroom's candles were counted. How many candles were in that storeroom at the end?

In the morning, a food pantry had 127 boxes of supplies, even though the pantry serves 500 families a month. By midday, 72 more boxes arrived from a school drive. In the afternoon, 17 more boxes arrived. By evening, 79 more boxes arrived from a church group. Later, six more matching pantries joined a distribution network, making the total seven times as large. Finally, 1,314 boxes were distributed to families. How many boxes were left at the pantry?

A movie theater had 164 seats reserved for opening night. A cancellation removed 77 reservations. A group booking added 76 more. Seven more matching group bookings made the total eight times as large. A late booking added 50 more. Another added 11 more. Finally, 75 more reservations came in just before showtime. How many reservations did the theater have by showtime?

A school had 18 trophies in its display case, even though the school has 20 sports teams. A move to a new case lost 15 trophies in the shuffle. Four more matching cases were combined, making the total five times as large. Two more matching cases were combined, making it three times as large. Finally, 26 more trophies were added from storage. How many trophies were in the display case at the end?

Two rival farms compared their egg production. Green Acres Farm had 194 eggs collected. A late lay added 9 more eggs. A shipment removed 143 eggs for a big order. A second lay added 62 more eggs. Finally, seven more matching coops joined, making the total eight times as large, far ahead of the rival Blue Sky Farm's 500 eggs. How many eggs did Green Acres Farm end up with?

A vineyard had 29 crates of grapes, tracked over 60 minutes, or 1 hour, of the first pick, even though the vineyard has 40 acres. Two more matching pickers tripled the total. Eight more matching pickers made it nine times as large. A shipment removed 679 crates for a spoiled batch. Seven more matching vineyards joined a co-op, making the total eight times as large. Finally, seven more matching vineyards joined, making it eight times as large again. How many crates of grapes did the co-op end up with?

A print shop had 182 flyers ready, tracked over 60 minutes, or 1 hour, of the first print run, even though the shop has a dozen printers. Eight more matching print runs made the total nine times as large. A late run added 35 more flyers, out of the 500 orders scheduled that month. Another run added 32 more. Finally, seven more matching print runs made the total eight times as large. How many flyers did the print shop end up with?

A thrift store had 99 sweaters on the rack, tracked over 60 minutes, or 1 hour, of the morning sale, even though the store has a dozen clothing racks. A big sale sold 89 sweaters. A donation added 80 more. A second donation added 63 more. A third donation added 32 more. A clearance event sold 34 more. Finally, a late donation added 37 more sweaters. How many sweaters were on the rack at the end?

Two rival bakeries compared their cupcake orders. Sweet Spot Bakery had 74 cupcakes ordered, tracked over 60 minutes, or 1 hour, of the morning rush. Four more matching orders made the total five times as large. A wedding order added 73 more cupcakes. A birthday order added 22 more. A school order added 70 more. Finally, a catering order added 47 more, well ahead of the rival bakery's order of 300. How many cupcakes did Sweet Spot Bakery end up with in their order?

In the morning, a factory had 184 units produced. By midday, six more matching production runs made the total seven times as large. In the afternoon, 366 units were shipped out for one order. By evening, 635 more units were shipped out for a second order. Later, four more matching production runs made the remaining total five times as large. Finally, 31 more units were added from a late run. How many units did the factory have by the end of the day?
